title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chad Muma elevated by Texans
items.desc: The Texans elevated LB Chad Muma for Sunday's game against the Browns.
items.impact: Muma will add depth in the linebacker room for Houston.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dare Ogunbowale elevated by Texans
items.desc: The Texans elevated RB Dare Ogunbowale for Sunday's game against the Browns.
items.impact: Ogunbowale will add depth in the backfield for Houston. He'll remain off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sabastian Harsh waived by Texans
items.desc: The Texans waived DE Sabastian Harsh.
items.impact: Harsh will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jake Hummel activated by Texans
items.desc: The Texans activated LB Jake Hummel for Sunday's game against the Browns.
items.impact: Hummel will add depth in the linebacker room for Houston.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Gracen Halton undergoes surgery, to be ready for OTAs
items.desc: 49ers DT Gracen Halton underwent surgery on the broken leg and dislocated ankle he suffered last weekend.
items.impact: Halton is expected to be ready for OTAs next year.

items.impact: Thornton will add depth in the secondary for Carolina.

items.title: Derrick Harmon (foot) activated from IR
items.desc: The Steelers activated DT Derrick Harmon from injured reserve.
items.impact: Harmon got in a full practice on Friday. He will return for Sunday's game against the Bengals.

items.title: Derion Kendrick elevated by Cowboys
items.desc: The Cowboys elevated DB Derion Kendrick from their practice squad for Sunday's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Kendrick will add depth in the secondary for Dallas.

items.title: Israel Abanikanda elevated by Cowboys
items.desc: The Cowboys elevated RB Israel Abanikanda from their practice squad for Sunday's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Abanikanda will backup Javonte Williams on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: James Mitchell signs with Cowboys' active roster
items.desc: The Cowboys signed TE James Mitchell to their active roster.
items.impact: Mitchell will remain off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Arden Key (hamstring) activated from IR
items.desc: The Colts activated DE Arden Key from injured reserve.
items.impact: Key will be ready to go for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) ruled out Monday
items.desc: Jaylinn Hawkins has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Chargers.
items.impact: Hawkins was limited in practice. He won't be ready to go for Monday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tommy Townsend (knee/Achilles) placed on IR
items.desc: The Titans placed punter Tommy Townsend on injured reserve.
items.impact: Townsend was already ruled out for Sunday. He will miss at least the next four games.

items.title: Peter Skoronski (hamstring) placed on IR
items.desc: The Titans placed OL Peter Skoronski on injured reserve.
items.impact: Skoronski was already ruled out for Sunday. He will miss at least the next four games.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Skyy Moore (ankle) activated from IR
items.desc: The Packers activated WR Skyy Moore from injured reserve.
items.impact: Moore will return for Sunday's game against the Vikings. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Brooks (ankle) activated from IR
items.desc: The Packers activated RB Chris Brooks from injured reserve.
items.impact: Brooks will return for Sunday's game against the Vikings. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Hunter Long (knee) activated from IR
items.desc: The Cardinals activated TE Hunter Long from injured reserve.
items.impact: Long will return for Sunday's game against the Rams. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zay Jones elevated from Cardinals practice squad
items.desc: The Cardinals elevated WR Zay Jones from their practice squad for Sunday's game against the Rams.
items.impact: Jones will add depth for a banged up Cardinals wide receiver room. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) placed on IR
items.desc: The Patriots placed RB TreVeyon Henderson on injured reserve.
items.impact: Henderson had already been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Lions. He will miss at least four more games. Rhamondre Stevenson and Corey Kiner will lead the Patriots backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tre' Harris (shoulder) off injury report
items.desc: Tre' Harris is off the injury report for Monday's game against the Ravens.
items.impact: Harris was able to get in a full practice on Friday. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ladd McConkey (back) listed questionable for Monday
items.desc: Ladd McConkey is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Ravens.
items.impact: McConkey missed back-to-back practices to start the week on Thursday and Friday. It will be risky for fantasy managers to wait on him on Monday in lineups.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Jacobs (finger) undergoes successful surgery
items.desc: Josh Jacobs underwent successful surgery on Friday.
items.impact: Jacobs had surgery on his fractured right ring finger. He is hopeful to return in 2-to-3 weeks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Garrett Wilson (concussion) expected to play Sunday
items.desc: Garrett Wilson is expected to play on Sunday against the Bills.
items.impact: Wilson has been trending in the right direction all week. He should be good to go after being sidelined last week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Adonai Mitchell (knee) expected to play Sunday
items.desc: Adonai Mitchell is expected to play on Sunday against the Bills.
items.impact: Mitchell was added to the injury report on Friday, but he still got in a full practice. He is a big play dependent WR3/flex play with Garrett Wilson and Omar Cooper Jr. also expected to play.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) expected to play Sunday
items.desc: Omar Cooper Jr. is expected to play on Sunday against the Bills.
items.impact: Cooper remains listed as questionable. He will be in the WR3 range for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Pat Freiermuth (illness) now questionable Sunday
items.desc: Pat Freiermuth is now listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Bengals.
items.impact: Freiermuth is a late addition to the injury report due to an illness. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Goodson (ankle/knee) placed on IR
items.desc: The Cowboys placed RB Tyler Goodson on injured reserve.
items.impact: Goodson will miss at least the next four games. Dallas elevated Israel Abanikanda as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jonathon Brooks (core) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Jonathon Brooks has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Saints.
items.impact: Brooks had his practice window opened by the Panthers. He was limited in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Legette (knee) activated from IR
items.desc: The Panthers activated WR Xavier Legette from injured reserve.
items.impact: Legette will make his return for Sunday's game against the Saints. He is likely to remain off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: David Montgomery (groin) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: David Montgomery (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's matchup between the Houston Texans and Cleveland Browns according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Montgomery will remain out despite trending towards a potential return to the Houston backfield this week for head coach DeMeco Ryans, putting Woody Marks (knee) in line to see the majority of backfield touches against the Browns Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) to be activated from IR
items.desc: The Saints plan to activate RB Travis Etienne Jr. from injured reserve on Saturday.
items.impact: Etienne is in line to make his return for Sunday's game against the Panthers. He should return to his lead role in the Saints backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Emmett Johnson to lead Chiefs backfield Sunday
items.desc: Emmett Johnson will lead Kansas City's rushing attack Sunday against the Falcons.
items.impact: Kenneth Walker is being held out due to a groin injury. Johnson has shown flashes this season backing up Walker and now gets his chance to step into the lead role.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Kenneth Walker III (groin) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Kenneth Walker III (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's contest between the Kansas City Chiefs and Atlanta Falcons according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Walker III will sit out after suffering a groin injury during Thursday's practice session for head coach Andy Reid, with Emmett Johnson in line for a sizeable increase in touches as the No. 1 option out of the Kansas City backfield against the Falcons Sunday.
